criteria.requirement: Add cssselect.batch.translate_many(records, *, translator=None, prefix="descendant-or-self::", fail_fast=False) as a lazy ordered iterator of records {id,css,ok,xpath,error}. Each input is (id, complete CSS group), including duplicate IDs; never concatenate groups or split commas. Catch only actual SelectorSyntaxError/ExpressionError into parse/translate diagnostics without value-bearing messages; continue other records, with explicit fail-fast rethrow. Forward actual translator and prefix, consume only requested inputs, propagate upstream generator and programmer errors and support empty batches.
必须交付授权源码、能在原版失败的公开回归和中文兼容说明；所有冻结原生回归通过。

comparison: 依据真实程序行为接受等价实现，不按参考文本或篇幅评分。
